# fct_surveys_advisor_live_training

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_surveys_advisor_live_training` · dbt area: `surveys`

Responses from post-training surveys collected by the AX team, including event CSAT and NPS scores. Each row is one response from an advisor. Sourced from Typeform.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `response_id` | The Response ID from Typeform. >> SOURCE - Typeform |
| `csat_rating` | CSAT (Customer Satisfaction) rating for a training event, a scale of 1-5 (1 = not Satisfied, 5 = Very Satisfied). >> SOURCE - Typeform |
| `email` | The respondent's email, typically their fora.travel address. >> SOURCE - Typeform |
| `event_name` | Training event name as entered in Typeform (may differ from event_name in Advisor Events Topic). >> SOURCE - Typeform |
| `event_type` | Event type (e.g., "Day of Learning", "Intensive") based on the form_id. >> SOURCE - Typeform |
| `form_id` | Typeform Form ID. >> SOURCE - Typeform |
| `likelihood_to_recommend_rating` | Advisor's response to how likely the respondent would recommend the training on a scale of 0-10. >> SOURCE - Typeform |
| `submitted_at` | Timestamp when the survey was submitted. >> SOURCE - Typeform |
